title: rosa coriifolia var. venosa
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. venosa, commonly known as the Kashmir rose or Rosa Kashmir, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Rosa coriifolia var. venosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-rheumatic effects.
